answer_1.quote: Fiction writers express their creativity through both low-level linguistic choices and discourse-level sequencing of narrative elements (e.g., plot events and character development).
answer_1.outputs: generated story continuations conditioned on narrative context and structural annotations

answer_2.quote: We devise a metric (inspired by ROUGE) on top of these edits that measures how much of the generated text is preserved in the post-edited version...

answer_4.quote: When users publish their edited entry, they are also asked to evaluate the generated text on a 5-point Likert scale... with respect to relevance (fit with the current story), fluency (judgment of grammaticality), coherence (logical ordering of sentences), and likability (subjective assessment of enjoyability).
answer_4.guideline: evaluate the generated text on a 5-point Likert scale with respect to relevance, fluency, coherence, and likability
